text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kiryuin and Happy Meek propose 
that both pairs continue to inspire and 
sharpen one another, acting as both role 
models and rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Specifically, it was a proposal to 
occasionally have "matches" in the future—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fierce competition should be great 
motivation for <chrname> too. I'm looking forward 
to future races!
